bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 2
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, BAW142, request de-icing service, we have light frost on the wings.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW142, Delivery, de-icing truck is on the way, expect departure in 20 minutes.

questions.question: What service does BAW142 need?
questions.explanation: 飞行员一开头就说 'request de-icing service, we have light frost on the wings'，即因机翼有轻霜请求除冰服务，管制员也回复 'de-icing truck is on the way' 予以确认。其余选项（加油、装行李、配餐）对话中均未提及，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR385, Wuhan Ground, taxi via A2, B and E7 to holding point of RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Taxi via A2, B and E7 to holding point, RWY36R, AFR385.

questions.question: How should AFR385 taxi?

options.A: A2, B, E7 to holding point, RWY36L
options.B: A2, B, E7 to holding point, RWY36R
options.C: A7, B, E2 to holding point, RWY36R
options.D: A2, E, B7 to holding point, RWY36L

questions.explanation: 管制员指令 'taxi via A2, B and E7 to holding point of RWY36R'，滑行路线为 A2、B、E7，等待点是 36R 跑道，飞行员复诵一致。干扰项或把跑道写成 36L，或把滑行道改成 A7/E2、E/B7，均与原文不符，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CCA4406, we have smoke in the cabin, the source is unknown, request immediate descent and return to Wuhan.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4406, Wuhan Approach, roger PANPAN, say your intentions.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Request priority landing at Wuhan, CCA4406.

questions.question: Why is CCA4406 making an urgency call?

options.C: Because there is fire in the cockpit.
options.D: Because there is smoke in the cabin.

questions.explanation: 飞行员发出 PANPAN 呼叫时明确说明 'we have smoke in the cabin, the source is unknown'，即客舱有烟、来源不明，因此请求立即下降并返航。选项中的失压、乘客窒息、驾驶舱起火均未提及，故选 D。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSH928, Wuhan Approach, follow ZS-03 Arrival, expect ILS approach RWY36L, descend to 2400m on QNH1009, Info P.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, ZS-05 Arrival, ILS approach RWY36L, CSH928.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSH928, negative, ZS-03 Arrival, descend to 2400m on QNH1009, Info P.

questions.question: What mistake did the pilot make during the readback?

options.A: The pilot was wrong about the Arrival procedure and missed altitude and Info.
options.B: The pilot was wrong about the callsign and missed Info.
options.C: The pilot was wrong about the altitude and missed the Arrival procedure.
options.D: The pilot was wrong about the runway and missed altitude.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令为 'ZS-03 Arrival'，飞行员却复诵成 'ZS-05 Arrival'，进场程序读错；同时复诵中漏掉了 'descend to 2400m on QNH1009' 和 'Info P'。管制员随即用 'negative' 纠正并重复了 ZS-03、高度 2400m 和 Info P，呼号与跑道并未读错，故选 A。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, CXA8321, we have traffic indication at 10 o'clock, 8nm, 300m above us, it's descending, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CXA8321, it's a helicopter on a training flight, maintain 4500m, reduce speed to 250 knots.

questions.question: Where is the helicopter?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'traffic indication at 10 o'clock, 8nm, 300m above us, it's descending'，管制员确认那是一架训练中的直升机，位置即 10 点钟方向、8 海里、高于本机 300 米且正在下降。干扰项分别错在 18nm、below、2 o'clock/climbing，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1502, ready for departure.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1502, cleared for takeoff, RWY18, surface wind 160 degrees 5m/s gusting to 12m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 119.7.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 119.7, CCA1502.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1502, 400m climbing. Our left engine is surging, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1502, roger, continue runway heading, turn left after 600m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue runway heading, turn left after 600m, request fire service upon landing, CCA1502.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CCA1502, fire service will be ready for you. Contact Approach 125.5.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 125.5, thanks, CCA1502.

questions.question: What is the wind condition when CCA1502 takes off?
questions.explanation: 起飞指令中管制员通报 'surface wind 160 degrees 5m/s gusting to 12m/s'，阵风达 12 米/秒，属于阵风（gusting wind）天气。对话未提及静风、风切变或顺风，故选 D。

questions.question: What happened to CCA1502 during takeoff?
questions.explanation: 飞行员爬升至 400 米时报告 'Our left engine is surging, request return to land'，即左发动机喘振，而非发动机起火、鸟击或爆胎，故选 D。

questions.question: Which frequency should CCA1502 call finally?
questions.explanation: 注意题干问的是最后（finally）联系的频率：虽然起飞后先联系 Departure 119.7，但发动机故障返场时管制员最后指令 'Contact Approach 125.5'，飞行员复诵 'Approach, 125.5'，故最终应呼叫 125.5，选 B；119.7 是干扰项。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3355, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 3nm right of track, expect rejoin the route at XS.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 3nm right of track, CSN3355.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CSN3355, we have weather indication 30nm ahead of us, request deviate to the right for 15nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3355, negative due to restricted area, can you accept deviation to the left?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 090 for 20nm, CSN3355.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3355, turn left heading 090, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Left heading 090, wilco, CSN3355.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CSN3355, we encountered severe hail, the windshield is cracked. We are emergency descending to 4200m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3355, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between KG and XS, all aircraft below 7500m, leave the route to the east.

questions.question: How can CSN3355 avoid the weather according to the pilot?

options.B: Deviate to the right side for 30nm.
options.C: Deviate to the right side for 15nm.
options.D: Deviate to the left side for 20nm.

questions.explanation: 飞行员发现前方 30 海里天气后明确请求 'request deviate to the right for 15nm'，即向右偏航 15 海里绕飞。heading 090 for 20nm 是被拒绝后改向左的方案，30nm 是天气距离而非偏航距离，故选 C。

questions.question: Why can't CSN3355 detour the weather from the right side?

options.A: Because there is a restricted area.
options.C: Because there is a prohibited area.

questions.explanation: 管制员拒绝向右绕飞时说明原因 'negative due to restricted area'，即右侧有限制区，并询问能否接受向左绕飞。禁区、军事活动和严重冰雹都不是此处给出的理由，故选 A。

questions.question: What happened to CSN3355?

options.A: CSN3355 encountered bird strike and engine failure.
options.C: CSN3355 encountered hail and the windshield is cracked.
options.D: CSN3355 encountered lightning strike and windshield crack.

questions.explanation: 飞行员 MAYDAY 呼叫中说 'we encountered severe hail, the windshield is cracked'，即遭遇严重冰雹、风挡玻璃破裂。对话未提及鸟击、发动机失效、严重颠簸或雷击，故选 C。

questions.question: Where is CSN3355 when he started emergency descent?

options.D: East of KG and XS at 4200m.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 'We are emergency descending to 4200m'，管制员随后向全体通报 'emergency descent between KG and XS'，可知紧急下降发生在 KG 与 XS 之间、目标高度 4200 米。7500m 是其他航空器避让的高度界限，'3nm right' 是此前因交通的偏置而非下降位置，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CES2159, 8nm final, established ILS, RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2159, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 140kts, report outer marker.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 140kts, report outer marker, CES2159.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2159, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36R, wind 350, 6m/s, gusting up to 14m/s. QNH1005.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36R, QNH1005, thanks, CES2159.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CES2159, we veered off the runway during landing roll due to aquaplaning on the wet runway, the nose gear is stuck in the mud. Unable to vacate runway, request a tug to tow us back.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2159, roger, tug is on the way. Break Break. JAL883, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied due to aircraft unable to vacate.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, JAL883.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, JAL883, we have 3 passengers injured during the missed approach, request medical assistance upon arrival.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL883, roger, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.4.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 119.4, JAL883.

questions.question: Why did CES2159 veer off the runway?

options.C: The runway was wet and the aircraft aquaplaned.

questions.explanation: 飞行员落地后报告 'we veered off the runway during landing roll due to aquaplaning on the wet runway'，即因湿跑道滑水（aquaplaning）导致偏出跑道，故选 C。阵风、前轮故障和速度过高均非对话中给出的原因。

questions.question: What was the consequence of CES2159's runway excursion?

options.A: Nose gear stuck in the mud, unable to taxi.
options.B: Main gear damage and engine failure.
options.D: Nose gear collapsed, fire on board.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告偏出跑道的后果是 'the nose gear is stuck in the mud. Unable to vacate runway'，即前起落架陷入泥中、无法脱离跑道，只能请求拖车拖回。乘客受伤是后续 JAL883 复飞时的情况，主起落架损坏、起火等未提及，故选 A。

questions.question: What was JAL883's request after the missed approach?
questions.explanation: 复飞后 JAL883 报告 'we have 3 passengers injured during the missed approach, request medical assistance upon arrival'，即因复飞过程中有 3 名乘客受伤，请求落地后医疗援助。请求拖车的是 CES2159，119.4 是管制员让其联系的频率而非请求内容，故选 A。
